definitions.gloss: handing off entirely, complete delegation, dumping
definitions.explanation: Passing on a task or responsibility to someone else in its entirety, often without proper guidance or follow-up. Usually has a negative connotation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸投|まるな}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To dump work entirely onto someone else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外注|がいちゅう}→外注：12153_gaichuu⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸投|まるな}げ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't just hand everything off to the outsourcing company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸投|まるな}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{失格|しっかく}→失格：12195_shikkaku⟧だ。
examples.english: A boss who dumps responsibility entirely on subordinates is unfit for the role.

notes:
{丸投|まるな}げ describes complete delegation without proper involvement.

ORIGIN: ⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧ (whole, entire) + ⟦{投|な}げる→投げる：01135_nageru⟧ (to throw) - literally "throwing the whole thing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{丸投|まるな}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (dump work on someone)
- {丸投|まるな}げ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧ (culture of passing the buck)
- {丸投|まるな}げ⟦{委託|いたく}→委託：05620_itaku⟧ (complete outsourcing)

USAGE NOTE: Has a negative connotation, implying irresponsibility or laziness. More neutral terms like ⟦{委託|いたく}→委託：05620_itaku⟧ (commission) or ⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ (entrust) exist for appropriate delegation.
